title: How Sumitomo Life’s leaders helped teams adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
summary_lines: Sumitomo Life uses ChatGPT Enterprise to research insurers, prepare proposals, and draft code for investment analysis. Early use by executives helped drive adoption.
